title: Egg Shakshuka with Lamb Koftas
description: A keto recipe featuring eggs poached in a flavorful lamb and vegetable sauce.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large oven-safe skillet over medium heat.
Add the lamb mince and cook, breaking it up with a spoon, until browned, about 5 minutes.
Add the onion and bell pepper and cook until the vegetables are softened, about 5 minutes.
Stir in the tomato paste and cook for 1 minute.
Make 4 holes in the lamb mixture and crack an egg into each hole.
Transfer the skillet to the preheated oven and bake for 12-15 minutes, or until the eggs are cooked to your desired doneness.
Season with salt and black pepper to taste.
Serve hot, garnished with fresh parsley or cilantro if desired.
